metadata.scenario_context: Jeff, Anne, and Sarah are colleagues at a tech startup and have decided to cook together to celebrate some recent achievements they have made within the company. They intend to discuss the recent news reports about AI advancements that could potentially benefit their business.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Canada have a great deal of confidence in the press at all.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Venezuela have no confidence in the press at all.

agent_1.goal_2: Question whether  there is confidence in the press.

agent_2.goal_1: Choosing and discussing the menu for their cooking session.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether there is confidence in the press.

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Jeff, have you ever tried making a salted dessert? I heard it's becoming quite popular. Maybe we could whip something up together? 

Also, what do you think about the recent news reports on AI advancements? I have a solid confidence in the press, unlike some people... Do you feel the same way?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message: Salted dessert? Hmm... I guess we could try something like salted caramel. Sounds interesting. But, about the press... I really don’t trust them. In Venezuela, the press is usually not reliable at all. I just can’t take their reports seriously. So, I'm not feeling very confident about those AI news reports either.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah
shared_prefix.message:

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff

It’s hard for me to see any reliable sources at all.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Sarah

I get that things are quite different in Venezuela. But in Canada, we really value the integrity of our press. I think there are definitely reliable sources that do a good job of reporting. 

Back to our dessert! Should we look for a recipe for that salted caramel? I can’t wait to start cooking together!
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Jeff
shared_prefix.message: I get that Canadians really value the integrity of the press, and that's great. I think we all want reliable information, right? Deep down, we are all the same in wanting to stay informed. But I guess our experiences shape our views. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, wanting to understand the world better. Anyway, let's focus on that salted caramel recipe! I'm excited to cook together.
